files.notes.md: POST /renders accepts a job for asynchronous execution. Authorization and schema validation happen first; rejected validation returns422 and stores no job. Valid request without an existing idempotency key: transaction inserts job in queued state and outbox row, then returns202 with job_id. Valid request with same key and same payload within12hours: return202 with existing job_id and current state; no new job or event is inserted. Same key with different payload returns409. Therefore202 does not distinguish a newly queued job from an existing job, whose state can already be running or finished. Queue dispatcher reads outbox; delivery may duplicate, worker claims each job using current state and does not execute a finished job again. Queued job may wait for free worker; no upper bound on start delay. GET /renders/{id} returns current state and completed artifact URL only for finished state. Request receipt is not start confirmation. Archive policy retains completed artifacts7days; billing invoices monthly; neither changes job-start behavior. Cancellation is a separate proposed endpoint and not implemented. Logs show job r52 queued at09:00 and worker claim09:03 in staging; not a start-time guarantee or production sample.
